sections.title: Static Deck Builder demonstration screen
sections.what: Shows a fixed Deck Builder layout with twelve sample slides about nuclear and LNG projects. Clicking a thumbnail shows that slide, and action buttons only show a short notice.
sections.why: Likely reason: a screenshot-ready mock lets the design be shown without the live app.
sections.watch_out: The slide text and figures are typed in, so they will not match any real project data.

summary: A static, hand-written demo of the Beacon Deck Builder with twelve sample slides about nuclear and LNG projects, meant for showing the design without a server.
purpose: Gives a visual preview of the Deck Builder layout for screenshots or design review.
why: Likely reason: the file is a standalone mockup so the design can be shown without the live app or data.
how: 1. The page defines styles and a set of fixed slide entries in a script. 2. It draws a thumbnail list and the main slide from those entries. 3. Clicking a thumbnail shows that slide. 4. Buttons with a data-action attribute only show a short notice.
inputs: Clicks on thumbnails and buttons. Nothing is read from a server.
outputs: A visual page with twelve slides and a fake assistant chat.
risks: The slides and numbers are typed in by hand, so they may be presented as real findings. Buttons do not perform any action.
debug: If thumbnails do not show, check the slides list and the thumbnail drawing function in the script. If styles look wrong, check the style block at the top.
